title: How to Go From 0 to 800k Followers on LinkedIn Using This Growth Strategy
description:

LinkedIn growth doesn't come down to luck or a bigger network, it comes down to a system. In this LinkedIn tutorial, we break down how to grow your LinkedIn in 7 steps.

You'll learn how the 2026 LinkedIn algorithm actually works, how to get more followers on LinkedIn, how to write hooks that stop the scroll, what "dopamine density" means for your content, and why LinkedIn Newsletters are the most underrated growth hack on the platform right now.

Whether you're a marketer, entrepreneur, or small business owner trying to build a presence on LinkedIn, this breakdown gives you a repeatable system, not just LinkedIn growth tips.
